{{Infobox Boss |type= |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Frost Talus Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Frost Talus Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |title= |race= |gender= |game= BotW, TotK |other= CoH, AoC, AoI |dungeon= |habitat= {{Spawn Locations}} |health= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{HP|BotW|800}} |TotK= {{HP|TotK|1,000}} }} |attack= 60, 2 |weakness= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Ore Deposit]] |TotK= [[Ore Deposit]] }} |reward= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{Icon List|BotW| * Flint * Opal * Sapphire * Diamond }} |TotK= {{Icon List|TotK| * Frost Talus Heart * Flint * Opal * Sapphire * Diamond }} }} |exp= 35 |theme= |strategy= |voiceactor= }} {{Term/Store|Frost Talus|Frost Taluses|Series, BotW, TotK, CoH, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Boss]]es and [[Sub-Boss]]es in the {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, CoH, AoC, AoI}} ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|Frost Talus}} Frost Taluses are [[Stone Talus]]es composed of enchanted [[Ice]]. They can be found in cold, snowy areas throughout the [[Hebra]] and [[Gerudo (Region)|Gerudo]] [[Region]]s, particularly the [[Hebra Mountains]] and [[Gerudo Highlands]]. These Taluses disguise themself as Icy rock formations. They are coated in [[Ice]] and will freeze [[Link]] upon contact, making it impossible for Link to climb them normally. Link can climb a Frost Talus when the [[Unfreezable]] [[Set Bonus]] is active, which can be achieved by wearing the upgraded [[Snowquill Set]] or [[Zant's Helmet]]. Alternatively, he can melt its Ice using a [[Fire]]-based attack, such as [[Fire Arrow]]s. The rock chunks that they launch at Link will always be coated in Ice. Link can defeat a Frost Talus the same way as every other variant of Talus, which is by inflicting damage to their [[Ore Deposit]]s through melee attacks, firing [[Arrow]]s, or using [[Urbosa's Fury]]. As part of the "[[Face the Frost Talus]]" [[Side Quest]], [[Gesane]] reveals that he saw a Frost Talus at [[Coldsnap Hollow]] in the Hebra Mountains, and he believes a [[Champion]] would be able to defeat it. To complete the Quest, Link must defeat this Frost Talus. Once it has been killed, Gesane will give Link a [[Silver Rupee]] as a reward. After defeating [[Calamity Ganon]] for the first time, Link is able to ask [[Kilton]] about Taluses. Since he is unable to approach them due to their size, Kilton asks Link to kill all of the Taluses in [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]] so he can examine the scent they leave behind. This task includes all Frost Taluses as well. When Link has accomplished this task, Kilton will give him the [[Medal of Honor: Talus]] as a reward.
